title: A surprise Lin-Manuel talkback with an even better surprise Sondheim ...
transcript: I've never told the story before, but it's. It encapsulates a little bit of what we've been feeling these past two weeks. Being here and watching this production here has been so special to me, cause I've worked here a couple times as an actor. I was in a production of Merrily We Roll Along here for our own course. And I remember Steve being in the position we've been in for the past 10 days with his crossword puzzle in the back. Kind of like doing the crossword while James Lapine is directing us. And I remember the night that they invited the original cast. And there's Lonnie Price and Ed Morrison, and, um, they all took us out to eat after. And there's an old Charlie next to a young Charlie and an old Franklin Shepherd next to young. And I turned to Steve, I said, Steve, how does this feel? And he said, it feels like Fucking Follies, for real. Because it was like a young and old everyone. And we were here with our original Broadway cast at the invited dress on Tuesday. And we got to watch that happen. And we got. We get to watch the people who grew up, uh, in a world where in the Heights always existed and was always like a role for them in the school play. Um, putting. Putting on the show they love. Um. And that's been very. That's very special and touching to us.
